decisions.reason: As a schlager compilation CD, it is very close to the firm's existing curation, label, and mail-order capabilities, so with industry demand growing and no negative market signal reported, it fits knowledge the firm can readily exploit and refine.

An illustrated music release series builds directly on the firm's established strengths in specialist physical editions and curated releases, giving it strong absorptive capacity to learn from early sales and improve the format rather than exit quickly.
